title: Business Development Executive
description:

 Asha Sweet Center
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Experience:** 
 1–2 years / Freshers welcome
 



**Type:** 
 Full Time
 



  





 BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Social Media Planning:** 
 Work closely with the social media team on social media calendar planning and ensure timely execution of planned content.
* **Photo Shoot Planning \& Coordination:** 
 Schedule and coordinate product photo shoots with the relevant teams, ensuring that all products, equipment, props, and other requirements are arranged and ready before the shoot.

 Coordinate with Swiggy, Zomato, Amazon, other quick\-commerce platforms, the company website, and retail managers to understand and fulfil product shoot requirements as per their respective specifications and guidelines.

 Coordinate and follow up with the factory for the supply of products required for shoots. Ensure that all products are accounted for and returned to the designated person at the factory/store after the shoot.
* **External Vendor Management:** 
 Coordinate with external vendors, including marketing agencies, printing companies, advertisers, and other service providers, as and when required.
* **Business Development \& Lead Generation:** 
 Identify potential business opportunities, events, corporate offices, exhibitions, and other avenues where the brand can establish a presence through stalls, stores, kiosks, corporate partnerships, or other relevant formats.

 Review and develop a strong technical and analytical understanding of SEO, SEM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other digital marketing plans proposed by the Grocat team. Present recommendations and observations to management and ensure that agreed action points are followed up and implemented. Also ensure that Google Reviews are monitored and responded to appropriately and promptly.

 Monitor scheduled posts and content published across various digital channels, ensuring that the content is accurate, timely, and aligned with the brand. Ensure sufficient content is planned and available well in advance.
* **Offline Marketing:** 
 Explore, plan, and coordinate offline marketing initiatives and other relevant marketing channels to strengthen brand visibility and reach.
* **Technology \& Tool Research:** 
 Research and evaluate relevant tools, software, platforms, and technologies that can improve business operations, marketing effectiveness, or overall efficiency. Bring relevant recommendations to the attention of senior management and follow up on implementation after approval.
* **Design Coordination:** 
 Coordinate with in\-house and external designers for the development of menus, signboards, packaging/boxes, pamphlets, catalogues, promotional material, and other brand collaterals.

 Safely maintain and manage all photo/video shoot equipment, props, and other related assets under their custody and ensure they are stored and handled responsibly.

 Present ongoing progress, upcoming plans, key initiatives, and projects in the pipeline to senior management on a fortnightly or monthly basis, as required.

* A
 **good collaborator**

* **Extroverted and confident** 
 , with strong networking and relationship\-building skills.
* **Dedicated, diligent, patient, and responsible**

* **Creative and resourceful**

 .

title: Account Strategist, Commerce, Mid-Market Sales, Google Customer Solutions
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Gurugram, Haryana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in sales, business development, advertising, account management, marketing, or consulting.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 2 years of Industry experience in digital advertising, consultative sales, business development, or digital marketing, working with advertisers, agencies, or clients in India.
* Ability to strategically assess and solve customer needs via sales techniques, including effective questioning, objection management, investigative skills, and engaging selling.
* Ability to build compelling narratives and utilize storytelling as an engagement strategy.
* Ability to think strategically about complex issues to develop recommendations/action plans.
* Ability to travel for customer meetings as needed, up to 10% to 20% of the time.


**About the job** 
 Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI\-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals. Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small\- and medium\-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage a portfolio of businesses and develop a comprehensive understanding of their business challenges, marketing objectives, and success metrics.
* Build an in\-depth knowledge of how Google advertising products work and can be used to help meet a wide range of marketing objectives.
* Build relationships with the end customer or agencies, and serve as a trusted advisor identifying opportunities for growth, creating multi\-quarter plans, and driving adoption of key product best practices to grow their business with Google.
* Collaborate within the team, and cross\-functionally to execute plans and ensure accountability to meet or exceed goals.
* Develop and refine a point of view to scale product, processes, and align priorities to drive customer growth, and help scale best practices to contribute to overall team success.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Business Development Associate (Intern)
description:

The organization is committed to elevating intellect and empowering students to pursue meaningful, future\-oriented careers.

title: Solution Engineer Sales
description:
**About Unosecur**
 Unosecur is a fast\-growing, Pre\-Series A startup with $5M in funding. We're a B2B security SaaS platform making identity security smarter and simpler for enterprises worldwide, with sales teams across the USA, Europe, and India.
   

  

 You'll be part of a diverse team working on cybersecurity and AI, with opportunities to solve complex problems and build production\-grade AI capabilities.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're hiring a Solution Engineer based in Bengaluru to provide technical presales support and drive Proof of Value / Proof of Concept engagements during the sales cycle, including with C\-level stakeholders. You'll partner closely with Account Executives to own the technical win in complex sales cycles.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the technical win. Partner with Account Executives and GTM to drive complex sales cycles from initial discovery to technical wins.
* Tailor the narrative. Translate complex technical identity risks into business value — explain an IAM policy misconfiguration to a DevOps Engineer, then explain the business impact of that risk to a CISO five minutes later.
* Execute high\-velocity PoVs. Run frictionless Proof of Values. Our technology connects via APIs and shows value in minutes — guide the customer through that data, highlighting critical identity risks (toxic combinations, shadow admins, over\-privileged roles) in their environment.
* Be a trusted advisor. Become a deep subject\-matter expert on Identity Security across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers (Okta, Entra ID), and business apps (Snowflake, GitHub) for clients and partners.
* Represent the voice of the customer. As an early member of the team, your feedback loop to Product and Engineering is critical — translate customer use cases and business requirements into clear feature requests to shape the roadmap.
* Evangelize. Represent Unosecur at industry conferences, webinars, and in technical blog posts.


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting within the SaaS or cybersecurity space
* Strong conceptual understanding of the major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) — how companies structure their cloud (organizations, projects, subscriptions) and the common security challenges they face
* Solid foundation in security concepts such as Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity \& Access Governance (IAG), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Least Privilege, Zero Trust, and compliance standards
* Exceptional ability to present technical solutions to non\-technical audiences — can run a demo and handle objections with confidence
* Proven discovery skills: asking the right questions to uncover customer pain points and mapping them to technical solutions
* Startup agility: prior experience in early or growth\-stage startups, with a bias toward action and comfort with ambiguity


**Nice to Have**
* Experience selling or working with identity providers (Okta, Entra ID) and cloud security tools (Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca)
* Able to read and explain scripts as well as REST APIs
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals, or similar

title: Technical Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Intelense, founded in December 2018, develops advanced AI software that converts complex, unstructured data into clear, actionable insights for organizations worldwide. The company began with real\-time video analytics for public spaces and now supports decision\-making and marketing intelligence across multiple industries. Its AI\-driven solutions identify trends, consumer behavior, and operational inefficiencies while integrating into existing infrastructures without major upgrades. At the core is KenAI, powering products such as KenVision, KenRobotics, and KenIoT to deliver intelligent event detection, behavior learning, and anomaly detection through seamless integration with IoT sensors, cameras, and video systems. KenRobotics further extends this capability with drones and autonomous mobile robots that provide granular insights and predictive maintenance to drive efficiency.
   

**Role Description** 
 As a Technical Sales Manager at Intelense, you will lead end\-to\-end sales activities for AI and analytics solutions, focusing on building and growing strategic customer relationships. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in the Greater Bengaluru Area and involves collaborating closely with product and engineering teams to understand solution capabilities and translate them into compelling value propositions for prospective and existing clients. You will conduct product demos, technical presentations, and solution workshops, prepare proposals and pricing, and manage the sales pipeline from lead qualification through negotiation and closing. On a day\-to\-day basis, you will respond to customer technical queries, provide guidance on implementation feasibility, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth deployment and customer satisfaction. You will also monitor market trends, support account growth strategies, and contribute feedback to product development to align offerings with customer needs.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Technical Sales and Sales skills, with a proven ability to manage complex solution\-based selling cycles.
* Candidates should possess Account Management skills to nurture long\-term client relationships and drive upsell and cross\-sell opportunities.
* Candidates should possess Technical Support skills to address solution\-related queries and collaborate with technical teams on issue resolution.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to ensure a high\-quality client experience across pre\-sales and post\-sales engagements.
* Relevant experience in AI, analytics, IoT, or enterprise software sales is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent business qualification is a plus.
* Ability to work on\-site in the Greater Bengaluru Area, travel to customer locations as needed, and collaborate effectively in cross\-functional teams.

 KidPro is a children's fitness brand, part of kprosport.com. Our mission is simple: make fitness a daily habit for every Indian kid. We run live, coach\-led classes that help children grow taller, stronger and more confident, right from their living rooms. Every week we put a KidPro demo in front of hundreds of families.

 We are hiring a Senior Closer for KidPro Live Classes. You own the moment a curious parent becomes a paying one. Every conducted demo is a warm lead handed straight to you. You call, you build trust, you handle the money question, and you close, fast. We already have a closer who sets the bar, and we are hiring someone who can match it and beat it.

 • Run disciplined follow\-ups on every warm lead until it is won or genuinely lost.
 



 • Hit and beat your weekly enrollment target.
 



 • Keep every lead, note and status updated in our tracker in real time.
 



  





**The Number That Matters** 




  





 Same\-day conversion is the gold standard. A demo closed the day it happens is worth the most, to the family and to you. A same\-week close is the strong second. That is how we measure a great closer, and how your incentive is built.

 • 3\+ years closing on the phone in EdTech, K\-12, insurance, or any high\-intent consumer sale.

 Experience selling to parents or in kids and education, a feel for subscription products, fluency with a CRM, and a calm, reassuring hand with anxious first\-time parents.

 • Fixed salary plus uncapped incentive on every enrollment.
 



 • Full\-time, work from home, anywhere in India.
 



 • Six days a week.

title: Founder's Office - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Founder's Office \- Strategy \& Operations** 





 LH2 AI Labs · Bengaluru · Full\-time · On\-site 
 




  





**Mandatory requirement: a bachelor's degree from a premier engineering institute such as IIT, BITS, or NIT, or an MBA from a leading business school such as IIM, ISB, XLRI, or an equivalent institution.** 




  





**About** 





 Built by second\-time founders who have built and sold companies before, LH2 AI Labs (lh2\.ai) is building the post\-training infrastructure for frontier AI models.
 





 We bring private, high\-quality institutional datasets and vetted domain experts to frontier AI pipelines across verticals like coding, computer use, agentic, medical, audio and more.
 





 For AI to keep progressing, it needs high\-quality training data drawn from real production use cases. The public web has already been crawled and trained on – there's nothing left there. That's where we come in: we envision creating a world where frontier models can access data on tap – exactly how they access compute today.
 




  





**The role** 





 We're looking for smart people to lead our revenue function – i.e., our data verticals – coding, finance, company operations, medical, audio, egocentric, and many upcoming verticals.
 





 Leading a vertical means an ownership mindset and owning the entire revenue stack:
 



* Working with frontier models to understand training data requirements
* Finding the right data owners
* Negotiating licensing rights and closing agreements
* Building the delivery data pipelines with our engineering team
* Ensuring seamless delivery




 This is not a role where you'll be making decks or Excel sheets. It's a carry\-a\-number, close\-the\-deal role that happens to sit right next to the founders.
 





 Here's how it works. We point you at a vertical – codebases, medical, audio, whatever's next – and you go build its supply from scratch. You figure out who in the world has the data and expertise we need, work out how to win them, and close them. You own the whole thing: who to approach, in what order, on what terms, and where the moat gets built. Each vertical runs like its own small business, and what you learn in the field shapes what the founders prioritise next.
 





 We can teach you the domain, the data, and the AI landscape. We can't teach you to think on your feet or to want closure. That part you bring.
 




  





**What we're looking for** 



* You can sell. 2\-5 years in sales, partnerships, or BD with a real sales cycle – ideally opening and building new relationships from scratch (new business / new logo, not just managing an existing book). You've carried a number and owned deals end to end.
* Genuinely sharp. Top\-tier education and/or time at well\-regarded companies – you've operated around a high bar, and it shows. You pick things up fast, and you can hold your own in a room.
* Consultative problem\-solver – you read what a counterpart needs, solve the problem in front of you, and build a deal around it.
* Think like an owner – comfortable shaping how your vertical goes to market, not just executing a plan handed to you.
* Comfortable negotiating bespoke, non\-standard terms.
* Sharp on quality: you can tell what's worth closing and what isn't.
* High ownership; thrive in fast, ambiguous environments.
* A generalist who has worked in startups before – hands\-on with tools, automation, and basic scripting, and comfortable figuring things out without a playbook.



  





**Bonus** 



* Prior experience in a programme management role.
* Opened new markets, categories, or accounts from cold – where the relationship didn't exist before you walked in.
* A track record of running many deals at once, against a target, without hand\-holding.
* Sold into small buying committees (fewer than five stakeholders) and know how to move them.
* Prior exposure to AI, data, expert networks, or marketplaces.
* Founder's office, consulting, banking, or operating roles at a high\-growth B2B company.

description:
**Founder's Office – Offline Sales \& Business Growth** 

  
 



**Lumov \| Bengaluru \| Full\-time \| In\-office** 




  




**About Lumov** 

 Lumov is a venture\-backed healthcare startup building India's leading pain management and orthopaedic solutions brand. Our portfolio spans orthopaedic supports, rehabilitation products, mobility aids and everyday wellness solutions, serving consumers through hospitals, distributors, retail and leading e\-commerce platforms.
 



 Founded by
 **Harvard Business School** 
 and
 **IIT Kharagpur** 
 alumni with deep investing experience in Indian healthcare, Lumov offers an opportunity to build a category\-defining healthcare company from the ground up in a fast\-paced, ownership\-driven environment.

 This is a Founder's Office position built around one core mandate:
 **own and build Lumov's offline sales business end\-to\-end, working directly alongside the founder.** 




 You won't be handed a playbook \- you'll help write it. This role is for someone who wants to learn what it actually takes to build a business: not just execute a function, but sit close enough to the decisions to understand
 *why* 
 they're made. Over time, expect exposure across hiring, planning, forecasting, and the broader strategic and operating questions that come with growing a company.
 



 Having a, analytical problem solving mindset is extremely critical with a zeal to execute and delivery results.
 



  




**What You'll Do** 

  
 



**Offline Sales – Build \& Run** 



* Design and stand up the offline sales function from scratch: territory approach, channel mix, distribution/retail partnerships
* Hire, train, and manage the on\-ground sales team as it's built out
* Visit distributors, channel partners, customers PAN India to build the business out
* Work on holistic business from hiring to tracking, performance management, sales \& business operations, etc.
* Negotiate with distributors, hospitals, vendors, across the value chain and close deals to deliver results.
* Set and own targets \- business planning, forecasting, and performance tracking
* Run a regular review cadence (yourself and with the founder) \- what's working, what's not, and why
* Troubleshoot in the field when needed \- this is a build role, not a spreadsheet\-only role



**Founder's Office – Broader Scope** 



* Partner with the founder on overall business decisions beyond your core sales mandate
* Get exposure to hiring, org design, fundraising conversations, and cross\-functional problem\-solving

* 2\+ years of experience, ideally in a startup \- operating roles, growth, sales, or general management
* OR a founder whose venture didn't work out, but who learned from building something of their own
* From a strong college/institute (open to newer\-tier IIMs / IITs and equivalent programs)
* High ownership, low ego \- comfortable being told "figure it out" and actually figuring it out
* Genuinely hungry to learn entrepreneurship from the inside, not just draw a title

**Compensation** 
* Competitive CTC
* Super\-normal performance\-linked bonus on top of fixed, tied to sales targets achieved
* ESOPs, vesting tied to tenure and performance (eligible after probation)

 You'll be one of the first people building Lumov's offline business, working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the founder rather than several layers removed. If you do this well, you're not just running a function \- you're learning how to build a company, with a real stake (via ESOPs) in the outcome.

 Rs. 25,000 per month during the 6\-month training period

 Opportunity to grow into functional roles in sales, marketing, operations, procurement, or business development based on your strengths and interests



  





**Why Join factori.com?** 



* Work directly with the company's leadership — no layers, no red tape
* Real ownership and responsibility from day one, not just observation
* Be part of a company that is building something new in India's commerce space
* Fast\-track your career — your growth here is limited only by your performance

title: Corporate Field Sales Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Axion Computers is a technology provider and systems integrator delivering intelligent software, infrastructure, and consulting solutions to businesses, organizations, and government entities. The company focuses on secure, efficient access and communication across diverse information resources and services. Axion sells a wide range of technology products, including computers, laptops, printers, servers, networking equipment, licensed software, and security solutions, with strong procurement capabilities across major cities in India. The organization aims to transform how clients approach technology sales and services by offering individualized, long\-term solutions. Its mission is to ensure sustainable client satisfaction through comprehensive technology and network services delivered with high quality and consistent attention to detail.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Corporate Field Sales Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru. This position is responsible for identifying and developing corporate business opportunities, meeting with clients, and presenting Axion’s technology products and solutions. The role involves managing the entire sales cycle, including prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, proposal development, negotiation, and closing deals. The specialist will maintain strong relationships with existing customers, coordinate with internal teams for smooth order fulfillment, and provide post\-sales support to ensure client satisfaction. Day\-to\-day activities also include preparing sales reports, tracking performance against targets, gathering market intelligence, and representing Axion at client visits, events, and meetings.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong Sales and Lead Generation skills, with experience in corporate or B2B field sales.
* Effective Communication and Customer Service abilities to build trust and maintain long\-term client relationships.
* Experience in Sales Operations, including pipeline management, forecasting, and use of CRM or sales tracking tools.
* Knowledge of computer hardware, networking products, and licensed software solutions is highly beneficial.
* Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets and work independently in the field.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, IT, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and analytical skills, with a focus on problem\-solving and client success.
* Willingness to travel within the region for client meetings and business development activities.

title: Senior Account Manager (SMB)
description:
**About Plum** 




 Plum is an employee insurance and health benefits platform for modern organizations. Our mission is to positively impact the health and financial wellbeing of every human.
 



 Employee health insurance has been the primary driver of health insurance penetration across developed countries. India is riding on the same wave \- covering 250mn people today, and projected to reach over 500mn in the next decade.
 



  





 But insurance in India still remains a hairy problem. No trust. Inhuman behaviour. Low awareness. Too much paperwork. Communication gaps. Overcomplicated systems. Too much fine print. Warped policies. Loopholes. Fear.
 



  





 With Plum, we are building the most trusted insurance \& healthcare partner for people and companies \- reimagining employee benefits to be accessible, inclusive and simple.
 



 Plum serves thousands of the world's fastest growing organizations including Zomato, Cred, Groww, Twilio, Rippling, Atlassian and Notion. We are backed by Tiger Global and Peak XV Partners.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 You get to be part of a team which is seeing disproportionate growth. 3 years ago this team generated 4 Cr of Revenue. This year we will generate 45 Cr. In 5 years, we want to build this to 450 Cr.
 



 If you are excited to work in a mission driven team where crazy business growth means opportunities for each individual to grow significantly. You will also get the learning that comes with solving complex problems in a space where innovation is not easy.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 You will be part of the Account Management team — the operational backbone of Plum — owning the end\-to\-end experience of a diverse portfolio of clients. From fast\-growing startups to large Global Capability Centres and niche enterprises, you will serve as their trusted insurance and health partner.
 



 This is a dynamic, high\-ownership role in a team that is scaling fast. You will go beyond reactive servicing — proactively building relationships, solving complex problems, and growing your book through cross\-sell and referrals. We want people who want to run a mini business of their own.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities:** 



* Own a portfolio of diverse accounts end\-to\-end — from onboarding and relationship building to escalation management, retention, and revenue growth.
* Become a product expert across our entire platform. Your effectiveness is directly tied to how well you understand Plum's offerings and how to position them for each client's unique needs.
* Make internal processes more efficient. You will collaborate across teams to reduce friction and deliver a seamless client experience.
* Build your book proactively. Once you've established credibility, drive cross\-sell opportunities and generate referrals from satisfied clients.
* Maintain rigorous adherence to SLAs and processes — because trust is built on consistency.



  





**Experience and Qualifications:** 



* **Years of experience \- 3 to 5 years of overall experience**
* You are an ace communicator — whether it's navigating a sensitive client escalation, writing a clear process document, or presenting a renewal plan. We see clear, precise communication as a competitive advantage.
* You are a true self\-starter. Plum values speed and we are looking for individuals who thrive without hand\-holding or perfect in formation.
* You are outcome\-driven and take extreme ownership. You measure yourself by the results your accounts achieve, not just the effort you put in.
* You have high customer empathy. You genuinely care about your clients' outcomes and go the extra mile to unblock them quickly.
* You are a strong problem\-solver who can work across cross\-functional teams to resolve complex issues.
* You have a growth mindset and are deeply coachable. We move fast and we will trust you to keep pace, handle new challenges, and raise your own bar ever y quarter.
* Plum believes in playing fast \& long, and everyone in our team is highly entrepreneurial and high on energy. If that appeals to you — you will fit right in.

title: Associate - Supply Operations
description:
**Associate — Global Strategic Partnerships** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 1–4 years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

**Job Description – Franchise Area Manager** 




**Position** 




**Franchise Area Manager** 




**Department** 





 Franchise Operations
 




**Reporting To** 





 Senior Operations Manager / Head – Franchise Operations
 




**Role Overview** 





 The Franchise Area Manager will be responsible for managing and driving the overall performance of franchise outlets within the assigned area. The role involves franchise partner management, operational excellence, sales growth, new store openings, compliance, issue resolution, and coordination with internal teams such as Finance, SCM, Marketing, Training, and Business Development.
 





 The candidate will act as the primary point of contact between the brand and franchise partners and will ensure that all outlets operate in line with brand standards and business objectives.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Franchise Partner Management** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships with franchise partners.
* Act as the primary point of contact for operational and business\-related concerns.
* Understand partner concerns and provide timely solutions.
* Conduct regular partner reviews and performance discussions.
* Ensure effective communication of brand policies, initiatives, campaigns, and operational updates.
* Drive partner engagement and improve overall partner satisfaction.



**2\. Store Operations \& Performance** 



* Monitor day\-to\-day operations of assigned franchise outlets.
* Track outlet sales, profitability, customer experience, operational compliance, and service standards.
* Identify performance gaps and prepare corrective action plans.
* Conduct regular store visits and audits.
* Ensure adherence to SOPs, food quality, hygiene, service, and brand standards.
* Follow up on operational issues until closure.



**3\. Sales \& Business Growth** 



* Drive sales growth across the assigned franchise network.
* Analyse outlet\-wise sales trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Track key business metrics such as sales, AOV, order volumes, discounts, online visibility, and customer ratings.
* Work with partners to improve outlet profitability.
* Identify underperforming outlets and implement action plans.
* Monitor aggregator performance across platforms such as Swiggy and Zomato.



**4\. New Store Opening / NSO** 



* Coordinate end\-to\-end new store opening activities for assigned outlets.
* Work closely with BD, Projects, SCM, Marketing, Training, Finance, and franchise partners.
* Ensure outlet readiness before launch.
* Track equipment, inventory, branding, licenses, training, aggregator onboarding, and other launch requirements.
* Ensure smooth transition from pre\-opening to post\-opening operations.
* Monitor the performance of newly opened outlets during the initial period.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 



* Coordinate with
 
**Finance** 

 for royalty, outstanding payments, credit notes, settlements, and other partner\-related financial matters.
* Coordinate with
 
**SCM** 

 for stock availability, supply issues, transportation, and procurement concerns.
* Coordinate with
 
**Marketing** 

 for campaigns, creatives, promotions, local marketing, and NSO activities.
* Coordinate with
 
**Training** 

 to ensure franchise staff receive required product and operational training.
* Coordinate with
 
**Tech/IT** 

 for Rista, POS, aggregator, and other system\-related issues.
* Work with the
 
**Legal team** 

 for agreements, amendments, notices, and franchise\-related documentation.



**6\. Compliance \& Brand Standards** 



* Ensure franchise partners comply with all brand, statutory, and operational requirements.
* Monitor FSSAI, licenses, agreements, certificates, and other mandatory documentation.
* Conduct periodic audits and ensure closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, quality, and brand standards.



**7\. Issue Resolution \& Escalation Management** 



* Take ownership of franchise partner escalations.
* Analyse root causes and provide practical solutions.
* Ensure issues are tracked and closed within agreed timelines.
* Escalate critical matters to senior management with clear facts, impact, and recommended action.
* Maintain an issue tracker and ensure there are no repeated unresolved concerns.



**8\. Reporting \& MIS** 



* Maintain regular outlet and franchise partner trackers.
* Prepare weekly/monthly performance reports.
* Track sales, collections, NSO, outlet performance, audits, complaints, and action points.
* Share business insights and improvement plans with management.
* Maintain accurate records of partner discussions and commitments.



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Outlet Sales Growth
* Same Store Sales Growth
* Franchisee Profitability
* Franchise Partner Satisfaction
* New Store Opening Timelines
* New Store Ramp\-up Performance
* Operational Audit Scores
* Issue Resolution TAT
* Royalty / Outstanding Collection
* Aggregator Performance
* Customer Ratings \& Complaints
* SOP \& Compliance Adherence

**Required Skills** 



* Strong franchise and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of retail/F\&B operations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple franchise partners and outlets simultaneously.
* Strong ownership and follow\-through.
* Good knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and MIS reporting.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.



**Experience \& Qualification** 



* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM preferred.
* **3–6 years of experience** 

 in franchise operations, retail, QSR, F\&B, hospitality, or similar industries.
* Prior experience in managing franchise partners and multiple outlets will be preferred.

**Key Competencies** 




**Partner Management \| Business Acumen \| Operations Excellence \| Sales Orientation \| Problem Solving \| Ownership \| Decision Making \| Communication \| Negotiation \| Team Coordination \| Analytical Thinking**

 AvancerPI Solutions is an enterprise technology engineering company focused on helping organizations modernize, automate, migrate, and operate complex IT environments. Founded in 2020, we have built strong capabilities across infrastructure, automation, cloud native and Kubernetes, migration, disaster recovery, platform engineering, and AI\-led solutions.

 To simplify enterprise technology transformation through deep expertise, intelligent automation, and engineering.

 To become a trusted global technology partner, transforming complex IT environments into intelligent, automated, and resilient digital platforms.

 We are looking for a customer\-facing Sales Manager who has personally sold enterprise technology products and professional services. This is not a lead\-generation or inside\-sales role. * Nutanix consulting, implementation, migration, automation and professional services.

 Exposure to Cloud / Data Center \| Nutanix / VMware \| Kubernetes / Red Hat \| Automation \| Migration \& Modernization \| Cybersecurity \| Enterprise Software / SaaS \| AI Solutions.

title: GTM Jr. Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
**GTM Jr. Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Account Executive (AE)** 




**Internship · Hybrid Opportunity · Sales** 




**Banao Technologies (ATGworld Networks Pvt Ltd)** 




**Bengaluru · Dubai** 




  





 We’re building AI into how companies actually run.
 



 We’re looking for someone
 **highly ambitious, hungry for bigger\-than\-life opportunities, and capable of holding a room in English.** 




 This isn’t a traditional sales internship.
 



 You’ll learn how to understand complex business problems, engage senior decision\-makers, shape solutions and help take them from
 **conversation → opportunity → deal.** 




  





 What we’re building
 



 You’ll work across our growing AI ecosystem:
 



 — Banao — custom AI engineering for clients. 350\+ of them, across India, GCC, US, UK. Running.
 



 — InterviewGod — AI hiring platform. Live, in market, selling now.
 



 — Vidya — AI learning and careers. Live, growing.
 



 — Vikaas — GTM intelligence and sourcing. Early, moving fast.
 



 — Axon — organisational memory for founders. Being built right now.
 



  





 The work
 



 You’ll be involved in:
 



 • Prospecting and identifying high\-value opportunities
 



 • Engaging decision\-makers and senior stakeholders
 



 • Understanding what a client actually needs—not just what they ask for
 



 • Translating business problems into solutions our engineering team can build
 



 • Supporting solution positioning and sales conversations
 



 • Building and managing a strong pipeline
 



 • Moving opportunities towards closure
 



**The endgame:** 
 You sit with clients, understand their real problem, shape the solution, and help sell it to some of the biggest enterprises across
 **India, GCC, Europe and the US.** 




  





 What we’re actually looking for
 



 You will not have all the skills. Nobody applying does.
 



 What matters is
 **how quickly you close the gap.** 




 We’d rather take someone with
 **20% of the toolkit and the hunger to reach 100%** 
 than someone comfortable with 50%.
 



 We’ll give you a structured, milestone\-driven
 **upskilling and growth roadmap** 
 —but you need to have the drive to keep up.
 



 We’re looking for people with:
 



 • Strong communication and fluent spoken English
 



 • Confidence to hold conversations with senior people
 



 • Ambition and competitive drive
 



 • Excellent presence of mind
 



 • Strong problem\-solving ability
 



 • Curiosity about business, technology and AI
 



 • Ownership and initiative
 



 • A willingness to learn extremely fast
 



 • Evidence of extracurricular involvement, projects or other meaningful initiatives
 



  





 This is NOT for you if…
 



 • You need constant handholding
 



 • You’re uncomfortable speaking to senior people
 



 • You wait for someone to give you a script for everything
 



 • You’re looking for a routine, low\-pressure internship
 



 • You’re unwilling to put in the hours required to become exceptional
 



**Fair warning:** 
 the learning curve is steep and the pace is real.
 



 That’s the offer—not a disclaimer.
 



 If you want to become
 **very good at GTM, sales and client\-facing problem solving very quickly** 
 , there aren’t many places where you’ll get this level of exposure.
 



  





 Who should apply?
 



 • Final\-year students who want to secure a role before graduation
 



 • Students who have completed one internship and want something more substantial
 



 • Recent graduates who are job hunting
 



 • Professionals with 1–2 years of experience who are hungry for more responsibility
 



 You should be able to commit
 **8–10 hours a day** 
 for the next \~12 months, including structured upskilling and work.
 



  





 Compensation \& Hiring Process
 



 There is
 **no fixed compensation number** 
 .
 



 The range is genuinely wide and is based on
 **your skills, growth and outcomes** 
 .
 



**Apply → Complete one task → We assess where you actually stand → Get your starting compensation \+ one\-year growth range \+ roadmap** 




 Shortlisting typically takes
 **1–2 weeks.** 




 If compensation is your first question rather than your second, this probably isn’t the culture fit we’re looking for.
 



 We’re not looking for people who simply want a job.
 



 We’re looking for
 **partners in crime** 
 —people who want to drive real decisions, real growth and eventually quote their own number because they’ve earned it.
 



**No artificial upper cap.** 




 We’re looking for the
 **one\-in\-a\-million.** 




 If you think that's you, apply.

title: Sales Account Executive - USA (Pod)
description:
**About Us** 




 Volopay is a Y Combinator\-backed start\-up that combines corporate cards, bill payments, approvals, expense reimbursements, and accounting automation into a single platform. We empower businesses to manage their financial operations seamlessly by providing real\-time visibility, control, and automation over their spending.
 



  





 We are backed by top investors and have expanded beyond Southeast Asia, now operating in the US to empower businesses with our innovative financial solutions.
 



 We need people who are deeply excited about our vision and passionately curious about transforming the way businesses manage their finances.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a driven and results\-oriented 
 **Account Executive** 
  to own the sales process and build strong relationships with prospective and existing clients. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying opportunities, understanding customer needs, conducting product presentations, managing sales conversations, negotiating with prospects, and closing deals.
 



 This is a 
 **high\-ownership role** 
  for someone who enjoys solving problems, taking initiative, and making things happen. The role will be fast\-paced, challenging, and at times ambiguous. You will not always get step\-by\-step instructions. You will be expected to figure things out, ask the right questions, execute quickly, and improve as you go.
 



 We are looking for someone who takes initiative before being asked, can work through unclear problems, pays attention to detail, communicates clearly, and follows through on what they commit to.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end sales cycle, from 
 **prospecting and qualification to discovery, product demonstrations, negotiation, and closing** 
 .
* Build and manage a strong, qualified pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, account research, and consistent follow\-ups.
* Engage CFOs, finance leaders, business heads, and other key stakeholders to understand their operational and financial challenges.
* Conduct structured discovery conversations and position Volopay's solutions based on customer needs and workflows.
* Deliver compelling, value\-driven product demonstrations tailored to customer requirements.
* Drive opportunities forward through effective follow\-ups, objection handling, negotiation, and closing.
* Collaborate with Product, Onboarding, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure a seamless customer journey.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline hygiene, and forecasting discipline.
* Stay informed about competitor activity, pricing dynamics, market trends, and buyer behaviour across target markets.
* Consistently achieve and exceed KPIs.



  





**Skills \& Qualifications** 



* **Ownership:** 
  Strong sense of ownership with the ability to independently manage responsibilities, take initiative without being asked, and follow through on commitments.
* **Independent Execution:** 
  Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and figure things out without requiring step\-by\-step instructions.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or a similar sales environment, with a preference for high\-performing SDRs ready to transition into a full\-cycle AE role.
* A proven track record of exceeding targets, winning recognition, or being a top performer is highly valued.
* Strong 
 **hunting and outbound sales** 
  capabilities, with the ability to independently generate and develop opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage the 
 **full sales cycle: prospect → meeting → discovery → demo → follow\-up → close** 
 .
* Strong understanding of consultative, value\-based selling and the ability to sell business outcomes and financial workflows rather than just product features.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior decision\-makers, including CFOs, finance leaders, and business heads.
* Strong ownership of sales targets, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with evolving go\-to\-market strategies.
* Data\-driven approach to sales performance, pipeline management, and forecasting.
* Experience selling to finance teams or multi\-location businesses is a strong advantage.
* Exposure to international markets and selling across different geographies is a plus.



  





**Success in This Role** 



* Build strong pipeline coverage across defined ICP segments.
* Consistently generate qualified opportunities through effective outbound prospecting.
* Conduct high\-quality discovery and develop clear strategies for each opportunity.
* Convert opportunities into predictable revenue through effective deal management.
* Independently manage the full sales cycle and maintain strong pipeline discipline.
* Collaborate effectively with Product and Onboarding teams.
* Consistently achieve and exceed targets.



  





**Work Location** 



* **Work From Office (WFO):** 
  This is a 
 **work\-from\-office role** 
 , and candidates are expected to work from the office.
* Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced and collaborative environment.



  





**Our Culture** 




 At Volopay, you'll work alongside passionate and talented individuals who bring energy and curiosity to everything they do. Our diverse team includes musicians, entrepreneurs, athletes, and many others who bring unique perspectives and experiences.
 



 We believe in giving people the independence and trust to take ownership, solve problems, and make an impact. Our culture is rooted in:
 


* **Ownership:** 
  We believe in freedom with responsibility. Take the lead, make decisions, and own your outcomes.
* **Results:** 
  We are a team of doers who stay focused on outcomes and overcome challenges with a can\-do attitude.
* **Curiosity:** 
  We encourage curious minds to ask questions, learn continuously, wear multiple hats, and embrace new challenges.



  





 Join Volopay and help shape the future of business finance while building your career in a high\-growth, global fintech environment.

description:

**Location \-** 
 Bangalore (Corporate Office)
 



**Work Model \-** 
 Onsite
 



  





**What would you be doing?**




 We are looking for a strategic and
 **consultative BD leader** 
 to own Growth Partnerships end\-to\-end from building the partner pipeline and closing win\-win deals to defining commercials and driving
 **acquisition, retention, traffic and ROI** 
 . This is a
 **channel\-owner role, not just sales** 
 \- you’ll use data to drive growth and build partnerships that create value for both bigbasket and its partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Build the partner pipeline \& close deals** 



* Identify, prospect and build a qualified pipeline of acquisition partners across all three segments (below); own outbound business development end to end.
* Pitch bigbasket’s new\-customer proposition, negotiate commercial terms, and close partnership agreements; build senior, lasting relationships at partner organisations.
* Maintain a forecasted pipeline that consistently meets partner\-signing and volume goals quarter on quarter.



  





**2\. Own the channel’s growth number** 



* Carry the target for new\-to\-bigbasket customers (First Orders) at plus reactivation of lapsed / lost customers.
* Be accountable for quality, not just volume: month\-1 / 2 / 3 retention, cost\-per\-retained\-customer (M3 CAC), and channel ROI against defined benchmarks.
* Set, forecast and hit targets by partner and by segment.
* Drive the wider value of the channel to new\-visitor traffic, brand visibility, and existing\-customer engagement through partner surfaces alongside the core acquisition and retention numbers.



  





**3\. Create two\-way value \& unlock partner funding** 



* Help partners achieve their own objectives on bigbasket growing their user and market share so bigbasket becomes a priority surface for them.
* Proactively secure partner\-funded campaigns and co\-marketing on the bigbasket platform. Partners already fund some of this; turn it into a deliberate, growing ask that offsets channel cost.
* Work with Category teams and brands to source brand\-funded offers that can be distributed through partner channels adding high\-quality, low\-cost offers to the mix.



  





**4\. Define commercials \& own the budget** 



* Design and negotiate partner cost / commission models (CPA, CPC, hybrid, retention\-linked) that hold blended CAC within target while rewarding high\-quality, retaining customers.
* Own the channel budget and unit economics; allocate voucher/offer cost and commission across partners for the best return; build replicable, scalable pricing frameworks.



  





**5\. Orchestrate handover \& cross\-functional execution** 



* Translate signed deals into clear briefs for the Offer \& Execution teams offer construct, voucher type, basket\-value (ABV) condition, target segment and inclusion/exclusion and ensure a clean handover.
* Partner closely with Marketing, Category (brand / vendor\-funded offers), Finance, Legal, Product \& Tech (integrations, coupon / series\-code setup) and Risk; coordinate go\-lives and drive iteration.
* Work hand\-in\-hand with Product \& Engineering to build the capabilities large partnership projects need features on the app or outbound channels, and direct technical / API integrations with the partner scoping requirements and shepherding them to launch.



  





**6\. Govern compliance, risk \& fraud** 



* Ensure partner agreements meet legal, regulatory and data\-sharing requirements — especially for banking and UPI partnerships (payments regulations, co\-branding norms).
* Own partner\-level fraud / abuse mitigation with the Risk team (device / address de\-duplication, verification) and tie commercials to verified, non\-fraud customers.



  





**7\. Decide with data** 



* Use cohort retention, incrementality (test / control), ROI and a partner / offer quality scorecard to decide what to scale, optimise or stop; run structured experiments and institutionalise the learnings.



  





**Who are we looking for?**



* 10\-15 years in business development, strategic partnerships, alliances or channel growth ideally in fintech, payments, e\-commerce, consumer internet, banking alliances or B2B2C.
* A track record of
 **closing and scaling growth / revenue partnerships and carrying a number** 
 not just relationship management.
* Strong commercial acumen: structuring deals, commission and pricing models, budgets and unit economics.
* Genuine comfort with data cohort retention, CAC / LTV, ROI and incrementality; able to direct and challenge an analytics team.
* Executive presence with sharp negotiation and senior\-stakeholder relationship skills.
* Cross\-functional leadership the ability to drive outcomes across many internal teams without direct authority.
* Experience working closely with Product \& Engineering to ship features and manage technical / API integrations with external partners.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred.



  





**Interested?**




 At bigbasket, you’ll have the opportunity to work at scale, solve meaningful business challenges and help shape the future of commerce in India.
 



  





 Join us and be part of the team building what’s next at bigbasket.
 



  





*Disclaimer: We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where different perspectives, experiences and ideas are valued.*

3M has a long\-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.
   

  

**Job Description**
 About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Regional Sales Manager – South India** 
 to lead the growth of our
 **Industrial Adhesives \& Tapes** 
 business across the region.
   

  

 This role combines
 **strategic sales leadership, technical solution selling, key account management, channel development and people leadership** 
 . You will work closely with customers and cross\-functional teams to identify new opportunities, solve complex application challenges and deliver sustainable, profitable growth.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings strong industrial B2B experience, commercial acumen, a customer\-first mindset and the ability to build and lead a high\-performing sales organization.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  

* Regional Business Leadership
* Develop and execute the South India sales strategy in partnership with Division leadership to achieve revenue, growth and profitability objectives.
* Translate market insights, customer needs and competitive intelligence into actionable business plans.
* Identify new industries, applications, customers and market opportunities for Industrial Adhesives \& Tapes.
* Manage the regional sales budget and optimize resources to maximize business impact.
* Track business performance and take timely corrective actions to deliver results.
* Customer \& Market Development
* Build strong, long\-term relationships with strategic customers and key decision\-makers.
* Lead complex sales opportunities, commercial negotiations and large customer engagements.
* Understand customer processes and application requirements to position the right adhesive and tape solutions.
* Drive new customer acquisition, product conversions, specification wins and expansion of existing accounts.
* Partner with Technical Service, Application Engineering, Marketing and other functions to develop customer\-focused solutions.
* Channel \& Go\-to\-Market Excellence
* Develop and execute an effective route\-to\-market strategy across the region, leveraging direct and channel sales.
* Build, develop and motivate distributors and channel partners to expand market reach and improve business performance.
* Establish joint business plans with key channel partners and monitor execution.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen market coverage and improve channel productivity.
* Sales Operations \& Commercial Excellence
* Maintain a robust sales pipeline and ensure disciplined opportunity management.
* Drive accurate sales forecasting and effective use of Salesforce/SFDC across the sales organization.
* Monitor revenue, profitability, pricing, product mix and other key business metrics.
* Use data and analytics to identify trends, diagnose performance gaps and support business decisions.
* Provide regular business reviews, market updates and forecasts to Division leadership.
* People Leadership \& Capability Building
* Lead, coach and develop the regional sales team to achieve business objectives.
* Establish clear priorities, performance expectations and development goals for team members.
* Build sales capability through coaching, mentoring and field\-based development.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of sales talent and build a strong succession pipeline.
* Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus and continuous improvement.
* Compliance \& Organizational Leadership
* Ensure adherence to corporate policies, professional standards and quality requirements.
* Act consistently with the company's values, ethical standards and commitment to responsible business practices.
* Actively participate in relevant corporate and Division initiatives.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Science.
* 10\+ years of core industrial B2B sales experience.
* Proven experience managing sales teams and regional business.
* Strong understanding of industrial customers, sales cycles and solution\-based selling.
* Demonstrated experience in achieving revenue and business growth objectives.
* Willingness to travel extensively across South India.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Sales, Marketing or Business Management.
* Experience in Industrial Adhesives \& Tapes, specialty chemicals, engineered materials or related industrial solutions.
* Experience working with manufacturing customers and technical applications.
* Experience managing strategic/key accounts and complex negotiations.
* Experience with Salesforce/SFDC or similar CRM platforms.


 Key Competencies
   

  

  

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Customer \& Key Account Management
* Industrial Solution Selling
* Business \& Financial Acumen
* Channel \& Market Development
* Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Leadership \& Coaching
* Negotiation \& Influencing
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration


 Measures of Success
   

  

**Success In This Role Will Be Reflected Through**
* Achievement of regional revenue and profitability objectives
* Sustainable growth across existing and new customers
* Expansion into new applications, industries and markets
* Strong strategic account and channel performance
* Effective pipeline and forecast management
* Improved sales team capability and performance
* Strong customer engagement and solution adoption
* Disciplined execution of the regional sales strategy


 Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M.

title: Sales Relationship Manager (Real Estate)
description:
**Company Description** 
 The Residentially is an online property discovery portal that helps plot buyers find suitable real estate options, including plots, sites, and villa plots from thoroughly verified and certified builders. The company focuses on providing a reliable, trusted platform for exclusive plot listings, supported by an expert offline sales team. Backed by a young and dynamic group of professionals and industry specialists, The Residentially brings refined knowledge and practical experience in the real estate sector. The organization aims to offer a seamless property search and buying experience through a combination of robust digital tools and personalized guidance.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Relationship Manager (Real Estate) will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end customer interactions for plot and site purchases, including understanding buyer requirements, recommending suitable properties, and guiding clients through the decision\-making and transaction process. This full\-time, on\-site role in Bengaluru includes conducting property presentations, coordinating site visits, following up on leads from the online portal, and maintaining strong relationships with both buyers and certified builders. The Relationship Manager will handle inquiries, negotiate terms within company guidelines, ensure timely documentation support, and collaborate with the sales and operations teams to deliver a smooth, transparent experience. The role also involves maintaining accurate records in CRM systems, providing market feedback, and contributing to continuous improvement of customer service processes.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong client relationship management and customer service skills, with the ability to build trust and maintain long\-term partnerships.
* Sales and negotiation skills, including lead conversion, pipeline management, and comfort with real estate transactions.
* Knowledge of the real estate market, particularly plots and sites, and familiarity with basic property documentation and regulatory considerations.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain options clearly and handle queries professionally.
* Proficiency with CRM tools and basic office software, and ability to maintain accurate records and reports.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with attention to detail and ability to handle multiple clients and site visits.
* Prior experience in real estate sales, brokerage, or customer\-facing roles is highly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, real estate, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Comfort working on\-site in Bengaluru and willingness to travel locally for client meetings and property visits.

title: Channel Sales Manager
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid\-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.
 



 As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting\-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.
 



 The Channel Sales Leader – India is a leadership role with end\-to\-end accountability for driving approximately 60% of the company’s India revenue through a scalable, compliant, and high\-performing channel ecosystem.
 



 In this role, the incumbent plays a critical role in strengthening channel capability, driving execution excellence, and enabling consistent outcomes across all regions in India. Also responsible for delivering profitable and sustainable growth through disciplined value selling, standardized operating processes, strong consultant engagement, service\-led differentiation, and strategic end\-customer relationships—while ensuring alignment with global policies, governance, and ethical standards.
 



**Key Accountabilities** 




**Channel Business Ownership \& Revenue Leadership** 



* Own and deliver approximately 60% of India’s total order booking and revenue through channel\-led execution.
* Drive achievement of annual targets across projects, retrofits, service, and parts, with a strong focus on profitable growth and margin discipline.
* Establish a standardized operating rhythm including pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, cadence calls, and performance reviews.
* Ensure robust funnel health, opportunity qualification, and conversion in line with global sales excellence frameworks.



**Value Selling \& Market Positioning** 



* Lead the adoption and institutionalization of global value\-selling methodologies across the channel ecosystem.
* Position offerings around total cost of ownership, energy efficiency, lifecycle performance, risk mitigation, and service outcomes.
* Equip channel partners with approved value propositions, tools, ROI/TCO models, and reference architectures.
* Ensure consistent and compliant market messaging aligned with global branding, pricing, and communication guidelines.



**Territory Coverage \& Channel Effectiveness** 



* Design and maintain effective territory coverage models aligned to market potential, vertical focus, and global go\-to\-market strategy.
* Appoint, develop, review, and rationalize channel partners based on capability maturity, compliance, performance, and strategic alignment.
* Define and govern clear roles, engagement models, and escalation mechanisms across distributors, system integrators, and solution partners.
* Drive consistent execution standards, reporting discipline, and compliance across all regions.



**Consultant Engagement \& Specification Influence** 



* Develop and execute structured consultant engagement programs aligned with global specification and influence strategies.
* Build strong, ethical specification influence with MEP consultants, PMCs, architects, and design stakeholders.
* Enable joint engagements with channels including technical workshops, solution days, and capability sessions.
* Track specification conversion metrics and improve spec\-to\-win performance.



**End\-Customer Relationship Management** 



* Build and maintain senior\-level relationships with strategic end customers, developers, owners, and enterprise clients.
* Provide executive sponsorship for large, complex, and multi\-stakeholder opportunities.
* Position the organization as a long\-term, trusted solution and lifecycle partner.



  





**Service Excellence \& Lifecycle Growth** 



* Partner closely with service leadership to drive service quality, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction.
* Expand channel\-led growth of AMCs, retrofits, upgrades, and digital/service solutions.
* Leverage service performance and installed base insights to drive retention, renewals, and cross\-selling.



**People Leadership, Governance \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Lead, coach, and develop regional channel managers within a matrixed organization.
* Drive structured capability development and certification programs for channel partners.
* Collaborate closely with marketing, service, finance, legal, and global solution teams to ensure aligned execution.
* Ensure strict adherence to pricing governance, compliance standards, risk controls, and ethical business practices.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 To thrive in this role, you should bring:
 



  





**Education and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering; MBA preferred.
* 15\+ years of experience in HVAC, building technologies, or capital equipment sales.
* Proven success leading large, multi\-region channel ecosystems within an MNC environment.
* Strong experience in consultant\-driven, long\-cycle project businesses.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively within matrix structures, balancing local execution with global alignment.
* Strong commercial acumen with a structured value\-selling mindset.
* Executive presence with the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.
* Deep expertise in channel governance, performance management, and compliance.
* Customer\-centric leadership with a focus on service excellence and lifecycle value.
* High level of process discipline, data\-driven decision making, and accountability.



  





**Technical Skills** 




 Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and AI tools.
 


* A self\-starter attitude with the ability to work independently.
* Creative problem\-solving skills and the ability to manage conflicts within various organizational structures.
* Out of the box thinker.
* Bringing in the culture of Teamwork among the peers.
* Proficient with CRM tools like Infor CRM, Sales force etc.
* Able to read through the CAD drawings other engineering tools to Understand and work on the projects.



**Soft Skills** 



* The capability to simplify complex problems, conduct root cause analysis, and provide clear, well\-thought\-out recommendations.
* Openness to learn.
* Team\-oriented leadership skills with a proactive approach.
* An ability to communicate openly and authentically in all situations.



**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?** 




 By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid\-flow technology while upholding Armstrong's commitment to sustainability. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: Mgr, Sales Ops
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
 At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
   

  

 Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Manager , Partner Experience CoE is responsible for leading Partner Program Operations, Program Assessments, Deal Registration Operations, and operational excellence initiatives that support NetApp’s partner ecosystem. This role drives operational efficiency, governance, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement while ensuring scalable and partner\-centric processes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine strong people leadership, partner operations expertise, and project management capabilities to modernize operations through automation, AI\-enabled solutions, and data\-driven decision\-making. Working closely with Partner Organizations, Sales, Finance, IT, and external vendors, this leader will enhance partner experience, optimize business processes, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team supporting partner programs, assessments, onboarding, and deal registration operations.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Establish performance goals, development plans, coaching frameworks, and career growth opportunities.

**Partner Program \& Deal Registration Operations**
* Oversee end\-to\-end execution of partner program operations, program assessments, partner onboarding, and deal registration processes.
* Ensure compliance with established policies, governance standards, and operational controls.
* Manage deal registration programs, including approvals, escalations, conflict resolution, and process optimization.

**Operational Excellence \& AI Transformation**
* Drive process standardization, governance, KPI management, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Develop and monitor dashboards, SLAs, and performance metrics to improve efficiency and service quality.
* Identify opportunities to streamline operations through automation, workflow optimization, and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Collaborate with IT and cross\-functional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve productivity and reduce manual effort.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Define project scope, timelines, success metrics, governance, and resource requirements.
* Manage risks, dependencies, stakeholder communications, and change management activities.
* Ensure successful project delivery aligned with business goals and measurable outcomes.


 Job Requirement
   

  

**Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in Partner Operations, Channel Programs, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or related functions.
* 3\+ years of people management experience leading operational teams.
* Experience managing partner programs, assessments, deal registration, channel operations, or partner governance activities.
* Proven track record of driving operational transformation, process improvement, and automation initiatives.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Finance, IT, Partner Organizations, and external vendors.
* Hands\-on experience implementing workflow automation, digital transformation, AI\-enabled solutions, or process modernization initiatives.
* Strong project and program management experience delivering complex cross\-functional initiatives.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong leadership, coaching, and team development abilities.
* Deep understanding of partner ecosystems, channel business models, and deal registration programs.
* Expertise in operational excellence, governance, process improvement, and performance management.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities.
* Experience with CRM systems, reporting tools, workflow automation platforms, and analytics solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Advanced degree or related professional certifications preferred.
