title: Business Development - Business Management - Analyst
description:
**About AQR Capital Management:** 




  AQR is a global investment management firm built at the intersection of financial theory and practical application. We strive to deliver superior, long\-term results for our clients by seeking to filter out market noise to identify and isolate what matters most, and by developing ideas that stand up to rigorous testing. Underpinning this philosophy is an unrelenting commitment to excellence in technology — powering our insights and analysis. This unique combination has made us leaders in alternative and traditional strategies since 1998\.
 



 AQR takes a systematic, research\-driven approach, applying quantitative tools to process fundamental information and manage risk. Our clients include institutional investors, such as pension funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations and sovereign wealth funds, as well as financial advisors.
   





**Job Description:** 




 The U.S. Wealth team was created to engage with taxable U.S. investors and their advisors.   • Hardworking and eager to learn in a highly intellectual, collaborative environment

  • Self\-starter, able to work independently as well as within a team
 



  • Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills
 



  • Strong oral and written communication skills
 



  • Knowledge of finance and the investment management industry is required

description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


Sales Support Manager **Your role and responsibilities:**

  

This is a 'Sales Support Specialist \- Electrification' role in Process Industries Division. In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the assigned Sales organization (Process Industries division) and customers during the proposal process. Each day, you will serve as a key technical resource in the assigned area. You will also showcase your technical skill by preparing technical descriptions of the products and technology, determining costs, and preparing final documentation.

  

The work model for the role is: \#LI \- Onsite  

  

This role is contributing to the Automation – Process Industries business. Main stakeholders are customers, EPCs/consultants, sales and engineering teams, product management, and project execution functions.

 **You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Delivering technical consultation and optimized electrification solutions by analyzing customer requirements, reviewing specifications, and defining clear scopes with transparent cost and responsibility mapping.
* Preparing comprehensive techno\-commercial proposals including bill of quantities, cost estimation, and competitive bid strategies while identifying and managing commercial, technical, and contractual risks.
* Collaborating with engineering, service, vendors, and product units to develop value\-driven proposals and support sales growth through technical presentations, workshops, and customer problem resolution.
* Driving customer engagement and pre\-sales activities to acquire orders, improve profitability, and achieve key performance metrics including order intake, Net Price Variance (NPV), and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Ensuring achievement of business objectives including revenue growth, volume targets, and profitable expansion across assigned product portfolios, industries, and geographic markets.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline from a reputed university or institution.
* 10\-18 years of experience in technical sales, bids \& proposals, engineering, or solution development for large\-scale electrification projects across Mining, Metals, Cement, Paper, and other process industries.
* Extensive expertise in Electrical Power Distribution Systems, including HV Substations (AIS \& GIS), MV \& LT Switchgear, Intelligent MCCs, Transformers, Busducts, Battery Chargers, Cable Management Systems, and associated electrical infrastructure.
* Extensive knowledge of motor and drive sizing, selection, and application engineering for process industry requirements, particularly in mining equipment, metals processing plants, profile mills, cement plants, and paper manufacturing facilities.
* Hands\-on experience in preparing techno\-commercial proposals, solution engineering, and customer\-facing technical discussions, supported by strong written and verbal communication skills with fluency in English.
* Proficiency in electrical system studies and engineering tools such as ETAP, with additional experience in E\-house solutions, substation automation systems, and integrated electrification solutions considered a strong advantage.

**More about us:**


The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on\-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

title: Sr. Sales Engineer
description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 Cohesity, the leader in AI\-powered data security, is seeking an exceptional Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer to join our team in India . This is a high\-impact senior role designed for elite candidates who serve as trusted technical advisors capable of engaging at the CTO/CIO/CISO level. You will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption of Cohesity’s cutting\-edge data security and data management solutions across India top enterprises Telco, BFSI, Pharma, Federal.
   

  

 As a Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer, you will leverage your deep expertise in data protection, including enterprise backup and recovery solutions like Cohesity DataProtect and NetBackup, along with strong knowledge of cybersecurity, enterprise storage, networking, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure (IaaS/PaaS). Experience with emerging AI/ML technologies in the context of data management or security is a plus. You will harness Cohesity’s expanded post\-merger portfolio – spanning data security, modern backup and recovery, cloud\-native protection, ransomware recovery, cyber resilience, and AI\-powered data management – to solve complex IT challenges and deliver unparalleled value to customers. We also expect you to bring a strong network and credibility within the India tech market, leveraging your relationships and reputation as a go\-to expert to accelerate Cohesity’s growth.
   

  

**How You’ll Spend Your Time Here**
* Strategic Technical Leadership: Engage directly with senior customer executives (CTOs, CIOs, CISO and other business leaders) as a trusted advisor, understanding their strategic objectives and aligning Cohesity’s solutions to achieve their business goals. Serve as a high\-level technical consultant who can speak peer\-to\-peer with C\-level stakeholders and instil confidence in Cohesity’s vision.
* Drive New Opportunities: Uncover and drive new customer opportunities by providing expert sales and technical guidance, effectively articulating Cohesity’s technology and value proposition to both business and technical audiences. Actively identify customer pain points and propose innovative solutions that differentiate Cohesity in the market.
* Solution Design \& Integration: Architect and design Cohesity data management solutions tailored to each client’s environment. Enable customers to seamlessly integrate Cohesity’s products into their on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, ensuring solutions operate flawlessly and meet enterprise requirements.
* Technical Presentations \& Demos: Communicate Cohesity’s vision and technology through engaging product demonstrations, workshops, technical deep\-dives, and whiteboard sessions. Develop and deliver compelling presentations, white papers, and proposals that address customer needs and highlight Cohesity’s industry\-leading capabilities.
* Proof of Concept (POC) Execution: Lead and execute proof\-of\-concept engagements that showcase the value, performance, and reliability of Cohesity’s platform (including our DataProtect and security solutions). Manage POCs from scoping and setup to successful completion, proving out both the technical merits and business benefits to win customer confidence.
* Technical Issue Resolution: Identify and troubleshoot technical issues during pre\-sales engagements. Work hands\-on to drive issues to closure – coordinating with Cohesity support, engineering, and product teams as needed – to ensure outstanding customer satisfaction and eliminate any roadblocks to adoption.
* Feedback \& Product Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering as the “voice of the field.” Provide structured feedback on customer requirements, industry trends, and competitive insights to influence product development and enhancements. Help shape Cohesity’s roadmap by conveying what our enterprise customers in India need to succeed.
* Post\-Sales Orchestration: Oversee the orchestration of post\-sales technical support activities by coordinating with Cohesity support and services teams, ensuring customer issues are addressed promptly and accurately. While you won’t be providing direct break\-fix support, you will own the technical relationship and make sure our customers smoothly transition to implementation and receive world\-class support experience.
* Cohesity Evangelism: Act as a Cohesity evangelist and industry thought leader in the region. Proactively share insights on modern data security trends (e.g. ransomware defence, zero\-trust, AI\-driven analytics) and champion Cohesity’s innovative approach at industry conferences, webinars, and community events. Build and maintain Cohesity’s reputation by being a visible expert in data protection and cyber resilience, whom customers and partners trust and respect.


**WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING**
* Extensive Pre\-Sales Success: 8\+ years of demonstrable success in a customer\-facing pre\-sales engineering or solutions architect role, proposing and delivering enterprise IT solutions at all levels of a customer organization. You have a track record of influencing decision\-makers and winning strategic deals with your technical leadership.
* Domain Expertise: Deep technical knowledge across data\-centric IT domains – including enterprise data protection (backup, recovery, disaster recovery solutions such as Cohesity DataProtect and NetBackup, cybersecurity \& ransomware protection (familiarity with zero\-trust principles and cyber resilience strategies), enterprise storage systems, networking fundamentals, virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper\-V or similar), and cloud infrastructure (IaaS/PaaS on providers like AWS, Azure, or GCP). Familiarity with AI/ML\-driven data management or security analytics is a strong plus.
* Strong Customer \& Partner Relationships: Proven ability to work effectively with both enterprise customers and technology partners.
* Executive Presence: Comfortable engaging with C\-level executives and multiple stakeholders in complex enterprise accounts. Exceptional presentation and consultative selling skills, with the confidence and credibility to lead discussions from the data center to the boardroom.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication abilities. You can distill complex technical concepts into clear, persuasive messages and adjust your communication style for technical staff, management, or executive audiences.
* Self\-Driven \& Collaborative: A self\-motivated, results\-driven professional who thrives with autonomy and proactively takes initiative. Equally effective working independently or as part of a cross\-functional team, you take ownership of objectives and consistently follow through.
* Adaptability \& Learning Agility: Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of technology trends. Willingness to constantly expand your expertise in areas like cloud services, cybersecurity threats, or AI applications to maintain your status as a trusted advisor.
* Travel \& Location: Willingness to travel as required to meet customers, partners, and attend events (travel roughly X% as needed).
* A strong understanding of the local market dynamics is essential.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Professional certifications in relevant domains (e.g. VMware, cloud platforms, security, or storage technologies) are an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and support high\-quality decision\-making.

 No two days look the same. In a given week, you might kick off Monday by reviewing WBR data and briefing AB Country Leadership on pipeline variances. By mid\-morning, you are deep in a territory rebalancing exercise to scale new CPS customer segment with the BI team. description:
Most travel companies sell trips. We sell the trip someone has been waiting their whole life to take.
   

  

 Our customers are 55\+. Many spent decades putting kids and parents first. When they call us, they're not browsing — they're booking the moment they stopped postponing. Your job is to hold that conversation with the patience and skill it deserves.
   

  

**About Eldergo**
 India's first travel brand built for senior travellers. Comfortable pace, safety\-first execution, group experiences that feel like family. Hundreds of trips delivered — Mysore to Mauritius, Kashmir to Kyoto. Founder\-led, fast, and obsessed with how every customer feels.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 You'll close warm leads. No cold calling, no campaigns. Start on weekend getaways, graduate to international (Bali, Bhutan, Dubai → eventually Japan, Europe) as you earn the trust\-weight of bigger tickets.
   

  

**WHERE THIS LEADS**
 Trainee → Junior Sales Executive → Sales Executive → Senior Sales Executive → Principal Sales Executive (sell flagship trips, report to the founder) or Sales Team Lead → Sales Head. Published bar at every level. No vibes\-based promotions.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 Hit your monthly seat target — close them with discipline, not pressure.
   

  

 Build trust on every call — answer the unsaid fear behind every question before it's asked.
   

  

 Run a clean CRM — every lead, every note, every follow\-up logged. No exceptions.
   

  

 Protect the brand — customer ratings count as much as closes.
   

  

**YOU'RE A FIT IF**
* 1\+ years in inside sales / travel / EdTech / real estate — anything closing\-heavy.
* Fluent English \+ Hindi. A third Indian language is a real edge.
* Comfortable on the phone with someone older than your parents — and respected on the call.
* Number\-driven. You check your pipeline at 9pm to know where you'll close from tomorrow.


**Who Should Apply**
* 1–3 years of experience selling products or services worth ₹50,000\+ over phone.
* Strong spoken AND written communication in English and Hindi.
* Comfortable speaking with a 55\+ age group.
* Looking for a role where performance directly determines your income.
* Available to join within 15 days.


**Compensation \& Role Details**
* Total earning potential: Up to ₹10 LPA (fixed \+ performance incentives)
* Working hours: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM
* Location: Bengaluru (remote during probation, office\-based after confirmation)
* Reporting to: Founder / Head of Sales


**INCENTIVE BREAKDOWN**
**Three engines: fixed pay \+ per\-seat incentive \+ milestone share when trips fill.**
* Fixed pay: Monthly salary that grows with every promotion.
* Booking incentive: Paid per seat closed. Bigger trips \= bigger incentive.
* Performance multiplier: Your monthly tier multiplies your incentive. Top tier earns multiple times the base.
* Milestone share: Pool that pays out as trips fill. You win when the trip wins.
* Strong performers earn meaningfully above the base. Top performers earn well into senior\-management territory.

description:
**About Hevo** 




 DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data\-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc.
 



 We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune\-based company with 2000\+ customers spread across 45\+ countries in e\-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper\-growth!
 



  





**Why do we exist?** 




 At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data\-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.
 



 Hevo Pipeline is a no\-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150\+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.
 



 Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40\+ countries to be more data\-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are growing into mid\-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar \- and the stakes \- are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post\-sale motion to match.
 



 Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart.
 



 As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets.
 



 You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management \- a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations \- architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior\-level technical engagements.
* Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co\-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
* Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
* Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance \- both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
* Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
* Contribute to internal knowledge \- documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post\-sales team.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Required** 



* 6\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role \- Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post\-sale or consulting function.
* Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse\-native transformation (dbt, etc.).
* Demonstrable ability to engage at the architectural level \- not just explain a product, but understand and speak to a customer's data infrastructure.
* Strong communication skills: you can make complex technical ideas clear to both engineers and executives, and you are confident pushing back when a customer's approach is suboptimal.
* Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment with a small team and high autonomy.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in a pre\-sales or post\-sales SE role at a data infrastructure or SaaS company.
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, compliance, or security requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.



  





**What You Will Not Be Doing** 




 This is not a support role, a ticket\-handling role, or a general customer success role. You will not be measured on ticket volume or response SLAs. You will be measured on whether enterprise customers trust Hevo at the technical level \- and whether that trust translates into deeper, longer, larger relationships.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive compensation and/or equity.
* Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post\-sale function is built.
* A collaborative, high\-trust environment where technical depth is valued and rewarded.

**Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Partnership Management** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 2\+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.**

 This role is the
 **primary commercial support to the Area Business Manager (ABM)** 
 and acts as the

 . It

 the ABM by ensuring the

 .

 and
 **ensure planning discipline,** 
 which are then
 **synthesized into area\-level insights** 
 that support ABM\-led decisions.
   

  

**Core Accountabilities**
* Area‑Level Sales Planning \& Consolidation (Primary Responsibility)
* Lead the consolidation of all zonal sales plans into a unified, coherent area\-level sales plan.
* Ensure alignment of plans with CU strategy, area priorities, and national guardrails.
* Provide the ABM with decision\-ready area planning summaries including risks, opportunities, and prioritization options.

* Integrate zonal forecasts to produce a single area\-level forecast, highlighting risks and trends.
* Ensure zones adhere to forecasting discipline, timelines, and data quality.
* Prepare and present area\-level forecast outlooks that enable ABM to take timely decisions.
* Highlight cross\-zonal vulnerabilities (e.g. stock issues, slow movers, weather patterns) and prepare area\-wide mitigation recommendations.
* Area‑Level GTN Governance \& Decision Enablement (Primary Responsibility)
* Aggregate all zonal GTN inputs (schemes, discounts, rebates, price\-offs) into an area\-level GTN view.
* Track GTN utilization at Zonal and Area level.
* Provide ABM with decision\-ready GTN insights, including value leakage, utilization efficiency, and execution risks.
* Support ABM in area\-led GTN trade\-offs (e.g., inter\-zone reallocation, scheme emphasis, focus Brand X SKU GTN needs).
* Ensure GTN discussions move from “zonal asks” to area\-level prioritization.
* Zonal Planning \& Execution Discipline (Secondary Responsibility — Input Management)
* Work with ZBMs to ensure high\-quality bottom‑up planning inputs, accurate forecasts and adherence to guardrails.
* Ensure planning, forecasting, and GTN processes are uniformly followed across zones.
* Identify zonal inconsistencies and bring them forward as area\-level topics for ABM review.
* Strengthen territory planning quality through coaching and structured cadences with ZBMs and TBMs.
* Area‑Level Performance Management \& Cross‑Zonal Insights
* Prepare area\-level performance review packs for ABM, integrating all zonal data into a single narrative.
* Distill zone‑wise performance into cross\-zonal themes, structural challenges, and portfolio insights.
* Present area\-wide drivers of performance, gaps, and recommended interventions to ABM.
* Ensure review cycles enable accountability, clarity, and timely decision\-making.
* Commercial Analytics \& Decision Support For ABM
* Generate decision\-ready analytics, including:
+ Zonal productivity and coverage patterns
+ Portfolio mix shifts at area level
+ GTN effectiveness and return

* Provide ABM with clear options, not just data.
* Process Discipline \& Capability Building
* Enforce standard Sales Planning \& Business Excellence processes across all zones in planning, forecasting, GTN, and performance management.
* Coach ZBMs/TBMs on forecasting, planning rigour, and data discipline.
* Build a culture of consistency, accountability, and evidence‑based decision\-making across the area.


**Behavioral Expectations**
* Operates with a service mindset toward the ABM, enabling area decisions with high\-quality insights and structure.
* Influences through clarity, structure, and data, not through authority.
* Brings calm, disciplined execution to complex, multi\-zone challenges.
* Maintains strong working relationships with ZBMs while ensuring the Area’s needs are met.
* Bias for closure, action, and follow\-through.

title: Inside Sales Executive
description:
**About Runable** 




 Runable builds software that helps small and medium businesses grow — the tooling, automation, and workflows that let a lean team operate like a much larger one. Our customers are spread across the globe, and they judge us by whether their business runs better after talking to us.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring an Inside Sales Executive to own conversations with customers worldwide — understanding what is actually blocking their business, matching it to the right solution, and growing the account from there. This is a consultative role: you are measured on solved problems and expanded accounts, not on dials made.
 



 You will be the customer's first real conversation with Runable and often their most important one. Most of your day is live customer contact — calls, demos, follow\-ups — with the rest spent on research, CRM hygiene, and working with product and support to get answers you can stand behind.
 



  





**Location : Banaglore \- 6 days work from office** 




**Preferably someone who can join immediately** 




  





**What You'll Do** 



* Run discovery conversations with customers and prospects across regions, diagnosing the real pain point behind the request they came in with.
* Recommend solutions you can defend — the right plan, module, or workflow for their business, and a clear no when Runable is not the fit.
* Deliver product demos tailored to the customer's business, not a generic feature tour.
* Own upsell and cross\-sell: spot expansion signals in usage and conversations, build the business case, and close the upgrade.
* Manage the full inside sales cycle end to end — qualification, evaluation, objection handling, negotiation, and close.
* Drive renewals and account health in partnership with support, catching churn risk before it shows up in the numbers.
* Keep the CRM accurate and current: every conversation logged, every pipeline stage honest, forecasts you can be held to.
* Follow up relentlessly and professionally across email, phone, and chat until there is a clear decision either way.
* Feed patterns back to product and marketing — recurring objections, missing capabilities, competitor moves.
* Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly targets for new revenue, expansion revenue, and pipeline coverage.



  





**Requirements** 



* 2–5 years in inside sales, SaaS sales, account management, or customer success with a revenue number attached.
* Track record of consistently meeting or beating quota — bring the numbers and be ready to walk through them.
* Excellent spoken and written English; you can hold a confident, clear conversation with a customer in any market.
* Genuine consultative selling ability — you ask questions before pitching and can diagnose a problem the customer has not articulated well.
* Comfort selling to SMB owners and operators, including non\-technical buyers.
* Demonstrated upsell and cross\-sell experience in an existing customer base.
* Strong objection handling and negotiation skills without discounting as the default move.
* Hands\-on CRM discipline (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho or similar) and comfort with sales tooling and dashboards.
* Enough product curiosity to learn a software product deeply and explain it simply.
* Organised and self\-driven: you manage your own pipeline, priorities, and follow\-up without being chased.
* Willing to work with customers across time zones and adjust hours when a deal or an escalation needs it.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience selling to SMBs in international markets (US, EU, MEA, APAC).
* Background in a product\-led or self\-serve SaaS motion, converting free or trial users into paid.
* Exposure to automation, workflow, or AI\-adjacent products.
* Experience building outbound sequences or working a mixed inbound and outbound pipeline.
* Familiarity with sales frameworks (MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger) and the judgment to know when to drop them.
* A second language useful for a market we serve.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




**Timeframe** 




**Expected outcome** 




 First 30 days :
 



 Product mastery, shadowed and then independent discovery calls, CRM and process fully in hand.
 



 First 60 days :
 



 Managing your own pipeline end to end, closing new business, first upsell conversions landed.
 



 First 90 days :
 



 Consistently hitting quota, a healthy self\-built pipeline, and a documented view of the objections and expansion triggers in your segment.
 



  





**How You'll Work** 




 You work from our Bangalore office alongside product, support, and marketing — which means a customer question rarely waits more than an hour for a real answer. You will use a modern sales stack (CRM, calling and meeting tools, sequencing, dashboards) and have direct access to the people who build the product.
 



  





**Why Runable** 



* Real ownership of your accounts and your number — no layers between you and the customer.
* Small team, high leverage: your feedback changes the product roadmap, not a suggestion box.
* Global customer base, so the problems and the deals stay varied.
* Compensation is benchmarked to experience and performance, with the incentive structure discussed openly in the first conversation.

title: Founder’s Office - GTM
description:
Hi, I'm Tushar, founder of OutFlo. We're a team of four building an AI\-native LinkedIn outreach platform for GTM teams and lead gen agencies. I'm looking for a smart Founder’s office hire to own GTM with me.
 



  





**Position:** 
 Founder's Office \- GTM
 



**Location:** 
 HSR Layout, Bangalore. Full time, on\-site.
 



**Compensation:** 
 As per industry standards \+ equity.
 



  





**Apply:** 
 https://forms.gle/fvvMt8erFUXtVsYeA
 



  




**About OutFlo** 

 OutFlo runs LinkedIn outreach on autopilot across many accounts at once, at a price where scaling it actually makes sense. For most of our customers, LinkedIn is now their biggest outbound channel. We have paying customers in the US, Canada, UK, Germany and India \- SaaS startups, lead gen agencies, recruitment firms. Capillary, CollegeDunia, TrueFoundry and BricConsulting are on it.
 



  





 I started OutFlo and my co\-founder Pravesh owns product and engineering. We're both IIT Kharagpur alums. Before this I ran founding sales at a Peak XV backed AI startup, took it $0\-1M ARR, and scaled LinkedIn outbound to 100\+ accounts. We're backed by angels who have built global AI companies out of India, including the founder behind the largest SaaS IPO of 2025\.
 



  





 We're starting with LinkedIn and going after B2B teams in the US. Long term we want to run the full GTM motion, from finding the prospect to booking the meeting, across LinkedIn, email, calls and social.
 



  




**About the role** 

 You'll be the core GTM person here. The outbound motion this company runs on is yours to build. There's no playbook waiting for you.
 



  





 It's customer\-facing from day one. You'll start in the DMs, move onto sales calls, and keep the relationship going after they sign. You'll also be posting content under your own name, founder profile and not briefing someone else to.
 



  





 You work directly with me. Real autonomy, real expectations, no layers in between. As the motion starts working, you'll hire interns and lead them.
 



  





 We're at 0\-1 and pushing hard. Some weeks are long. If you enjoy this phase you'll love it here, but if you're counting hours, this isn't the role.
 



  




**What you'll do** 
* Build the outbound motion. Targeted lists, signal\-based campaigns across our LinkedIn accounts, messaging, replies, booked meetings.
* Talk to prospects and customers. DMs first, then sales calls, then keeping the accounts happy after they sign.
* Own content. LinkedIn, Reddit and wherever else works. You write and post it yourself.
* Whatever is most important that week. SEO, partnership calls, a new channel worth testing.
* Hire and lead interns once there's a motion worth scaling.
* Run our own product every day and tell us what's broken in it.



  




**Who I’m looking for** 

  




* 1\-2 years at a startup in a similar role. Graduated 2022\-2025\.
* You've run outbound yourself. Built the list, sent the messages, owned the replies, booked the meetings. Not managed someone who did.
* Resourceful. You find a way with what's in front of you.
* You follow this space. You know what Clay, Instantly and HeyReach are shipping, and how GTM engineers are running different motions.
* You write well and you're comfortable posting as yourself. You'll be writing all day \- DMs, posts, emails, customer replies.
* You use Claude or similar every day to move faster, but you don't outsource your thinking or your creativity to it.
* You want to start your own company in 2\-3 years, and want the closest thing to founder experience without the cap table.



  




**Why us**

 We're a GTM startup building a GTM product. You'll sell the thing you use all day, and that makes you better at both.
 



  





 We're up against HeyReach. It has scaled really well and customers are already switching to us from them. That's a hard fight, and it's the one worth picking.
 



  





 The ambition isn't an India\-only tool. It's a world\-class product built from Bangalore, with paying customers in 5 countries already and most of our demand coming from the US.
 



  





 You'll own the channel that brings in every one of those customers, and build the team under you.
 



  





**Apply here:** 
 https://forms.gle/fvvMt8erFUXtVsYeA
 



  





 Best,
 



 Tushar Singla
 



 Founder, OutFlo AI \| tushar@outflo.io \| LinkedIn

description:
Company: DigiMark Agency (DigiMark Online Services Pvt. Ltd.)
 



 Location: Bengaluru (on\-site)

**About DigiMark Agency** 




 DigiMark Agency is the digital marketing vertical of PropertyPlush Group, a multi\-entity hospitality and real estate operator platform. We run performance marketing, brand, and growth campaigns for businesses across hospitality, real estate, and consumer sectors — and we're scaling our client acquisition engine. That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll be the first touchpoint in our sales funnel. Your job is to find the right prospects, reach them before our competitors do, and book qualified conversations for the sales team. This is a revenue\-facing role — you'll see the direct link between your outreach and closed deals, and your incentives are tied to it.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Build and enrich prospect lists (target industries, decision\-makers, contact data) for outbound campaigns
* Execute multi\-channel outreach — cold email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and calls — using approved sequences and messaging
* Personalize outreach at scale: research each prospect's business and tailor the first line, not just the name field
* Follow up relentlessly and manage response handling — qualify interest, answer first\-level questions, and book discovery calls for the sales team
* Keep the CRM (Zoho) clean and current: log every touch, update lead stages, flag hot leads same\-day
* Track campaign metrics (open, reply, meeting\-booked rates) and report weekly on what's working
* Assist in preparing pre\-sales collateral — pitch decks, case\-study one\-pagers, and proposal inputs



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 Must have:
 


* 0–2 years of experience; graduates from any stream — hunger matters more than pedigree
* Excellent written and spoken English; conversational Kannada/Hindi a plus for local outreach
* Comfortable making cold calls and handling rejection without losing momentum
* Basic proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets and LinkedIn



 Nice to have:
 


* Internship or work experience in sales, BD, or lead generation
* Familiarity with any CRM, email outreach tools, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Understanding of digital marketing services (SEO, performance ads, social media)



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 By day 30 you're running outreach sequences independently. By day 60 you're consistently booking qualified meetings weekly. By day 90 you own a target segment end\-to\-end and your pipeline contribution is visible in revenue conversations.
 



  





**Career Path** 



* This is the entry point into our revenue organization. High performers move into Account Executive / client\-facing sales roles, with a defined review at 6 and 12 months. You'll work directly with agency leadership — no layers between you and decision\-makers — across a group that spans hospitality, real estate, and events.

description:
Job Title
   

  

 Pre\-Sales Technical Specialist, ACI Growth
   

  

**Job Description**
 In this position, you will provide pre\-sales technical leadership for the Philips Capsule Medical Device Information (MDI), IntelliBridge Enterprise (IBE), IntelliSpace Critical Care and Anesthesia (ICCA), eCareManager (eCM), and Clinical Insight Manager (CIM) product lines, supporting growth across India, APAC, and META.
   

  

**Minimum Required Education**
 Bachelor's/master’s degree in computer science or a health science, or equivalent.
   

  

**Minimum Required Experience**
 Minimum of 4 years of experience working within a commercial capacity in the Healthcare Technology, Healthcare Analytics, or Information Technology area.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Act as the primary technical expert for ACI products, with a focus on Capsule MDI, in assigned regions during presales engagements and supporting the sales team with any technical support.
* Own solution architecture design, sizing, assumptions and technical risk identification for opportunities.
* Actively participate in documentation during the pre\-sales process, such as Solution Design Documents (SDD), Solution Architectures, and Statements of Work.
* Take ownership and provide feedback on pre\-sales artifacts, including document repositories, demonstrations, proof\-of\-concept (POC) environments and bundles.
* Maintain knowledge of market trends, healthcare interoperability standards, competitive offerings and industry best practices.
* Support competitive analysis activities and provide technical differentiation against competitor solutions.
* Lead technical discovery, architecture workshops, solution walkthroughs, site assessments and demonstrations with customers and partners.
* Define end\-to\-end data flows from bedside devices via the Capsule MDIP to third\-party solutions, such as CIS and EMR systems.
* Provide pre\-sales expertise across:
+ Capsule MDI platform, including device integrations
+ IBE/Interoperability (HL7, ADT/ORU, downstream systems)
+ IntelliSpace Critical Care and Anesthesia (ICCA)
+ eCare Manager (eCM)
+ Clinical Insights Manager (CIM)
+ While also supporting other products within the ACI portfolio

* Conduct detailed workflow assessments, device connectivity assessments and technical site surveys to validate solution feasibility and implementation assumptions.
* Ensure alignment with hospital IT organisations across security, networking, infrastructure and availability requirements.
* Participate in handover to delivery (HTD) to ensure clarity and solution intent, including assisting implementation and delivery when necessary.
* Contribute to deal governance, risk reviews, and internal approvals for any sales opportunities.
* Be the subject matter expert (SME) for Capsule MDI across META and India.
* Additional responsibilities for providing pre\-sales expertise for the IntelliBridge Enterprise and Clinical Insight Manager.
* Ability and willingness to travel across India, META and APAC markets as required to support customer engagements, workshops and demonstrations.


**You’re the right fit if**
* You have hands\-on experience supporting, designing, implementing, or selling healthcare software solutions such as Clinical Information Systems (CIS), Electronic Medical Records (EMR/EHR), Medical Device Integration platforms, interoperability solutions, or clinical analytics platforms.
* You have experience presenting, designing, influencing and advising customers on complex technical solutions throughout the sales lifecycle, from discovery and qualification through solution design, proposal development and technical validation.
* You have a strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking, cloud platforms, cybersecurity principles, healthcare interoperability and integration technologies, including HL7, FHIR, APIs, SQL, XML/JSON, ADT/ORM/ORU workflows.
* You are an effective communicator who can clearly articulate both technical concepts and business value to clinical, technical, and executive stakeholders.
* You are self\-motivated, adaptable and collaborative, with a willingness to learn, embrace new challenges, work across multiple cultures and geographies, and contribute to a high\-performing regional team.


**How We Work Together**
 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week.
   

  

 Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities.
   

  

 Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
   

  

 Indicate if this role is an office/field/onsite role.

 We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

description:
**Introduction**
 At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you’ll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co\-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You’ll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world\-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that’s passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 Confluent is seeking a highly motivated and results\-oriented Sales Executive to drive revenue growth globally for Data Streaming Platform (DSP) workloads. This role focuses on acquiring, building and managing strategic partnerships with first line AE/SEs, Product Management, Partners, and Marketing. The successful candidate will be a proven sales professional with a strong track record of building revenue streams and business value, specifically within the data infrastructure space.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Develop \& Drive DSP Sales Motion: Develop and execute a regional go\-to\-market strategy to identify key personas and a GTM Motion for each that align with Confluent's strategic goals and focus on capturing DSP workloads from Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and ETL/Reverse ETL vendors (Shift Left) and preparing AI\-Ready data.
* Define Clear Objectives: Target segments, and key performance indicators (KPIs), and create targeted sales campaigns utilizing direct sales, digital marketing, and partner channels to drive awareness and interest in Confluent's DSP solutions.
* Execute and Land New Streaming Projects: Engage with key stakeholders within target organizations and internally to understand their pain points and business objectives, presenting tailored solutions that demonstrate the value of using Confluent's platform for processing raw (bronze) data into more meaningful data for operational, AI, and analytics use cases.
* Hunt for New Opportunities: Proactively prospect and develop a robust sales pipeline. Identify and qualify potential partners based on their market reach, technical capabilities, and alignment with Confluent's strategic objectives.
* Build Strategic Partnerships: Cultivate strong, long\-term relationships with key decision\-makers within target accounts and ecosystem. Evangelize mutually beneficial partnership agreements that drive revenue growth for both organizations.
* Evangelize Confluent's DSP Capabilities: Clearly articulate the value proposition of Confluent's streaming platform to technical and business audiences within partner organizations. Showcase the benefits of using Kafka and Confluent for DSP workloads.
* Develop Compelling Sales Presentations: Create and deliver persuasive presentations that highlight the revenue\-generating potential of partnering with Confluent. Tailor presentations to the specific needs and priorities of each potential partner.
* Collaborate with Partners: Work closely with partner organizations to develop joint go\-to\-market plans, co\-marketing initiatives, and sales enablement programs.
* Stay Ahead of the Curve: Maintain a deep understanding of the evolving data streaming landscape, emerging technologies, and competitive dynamics.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Proven Data Analytics Sales Experience: Demonstrated success in selling analytics software solutions, ideally within the data infrastructure, database, open source, messaging, or big data space.
* Hunter Mentality: A proactive and results\-oriented approach to sales with a proven ability to identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities.
* Strong Technical Acumen: A solid understanding of data streaming concepts, Kafka, and the Confluent platform. Ability to effectively communicate technical value to both technical and business audiences.

description:
**LinkedIn:**

**AIM Print:** 
 https://aim.media/aim\-print

 https://www.youtube.com/@aimmediahouse
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 Own the subscriber base and circulation revenue across both print and digital editions. This is a target\-carrying role: you grow paid subscriptions, retain existing subscribers, and expand print reach by placing the magazine at high\-footfall stands, retail outlets, and partner locations. You sit at the intersection of sales, distribution logistics, and audience data.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Digital Subscriptions** 




 • Drive paid digital subscription growth across web and app, including individual and corporate/institutional plans.
 



 • Build and run acquisition funnels: landing pages, paywall offers, trial\-to\-paid conversion, and renewal flows.
 



 • Reduce churn through lifecycle campaigns, win\-back offers, and pricing/bundling experiments.
 



 • Manage subscription platform and payment gateway operations, including auto\-renewals and failed\-payment recovery.
 



**Print Subscriptions** 




 • Grow direct print subscriptions across individual, gift, and bulk/corporate orders.
 



 • Manage the full subscriber cycle: order capture, fulfilment coordination, address data accuracy, and renewals.
 



 • Coordinate with the print and dispatch teams to ensure on\-time delivery and resolve delivery complaints.
 



**Circulation \& Distribution to Stands** 




 • Expand physical reach by placing print copies at newsstands, bookstores, airports, cafes, co\-working spaces, and event venues.
 



 • Build and manage relationships with distributors, vendors, and retail partners; negotiate placement, margins, and sale\-or\-return terms.
 



 • Plan copy allocation per outlet, track sell\-through, and adjust print run and distribution mix based on what each location actually sells.
 



 • Handle returns reconciliation, stand\-level reporting, and route/territory planning to keep distribution cost\-efficient.
 



**Sales Targets \& Revenue** 




 • Carry and deliver monthly and quarterly targets for subscriber count and circulation revenue across both formats.
 



 • Forecast subscription and newsstand revenue; report performance against target with clear variance analysis.
 



 • Identify and close institutional and bulk deals (corporates, libraries, universities, event partners).
 



**Data \& Reporting** 




 • Maintain a single source of truth for subscriber and circulation data; track acquisition cost, retention, LTV, and sell\-through by channel and outlet.
 



 • Report weekly on pipeline, conversions, renewals, and stand performance to leadership.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)** 




 • Subscriber growth — net new paid subscribers (print \+ digital) against target.
 



 • Circulation revenue — total subscription and newsstand revenue vs. target.
 



 • Retention — renewal and churn rates across both formats.
 



 • Distribution reach — number of active stands/outlets and average sell\-through per outlet.
 



 • Efficiency — subscriber acquisition cost and returns rate kept within agreed limits.
 



  





**Requirements** 




 • 10\+ years in subscriptions, circulation, distribution, or sales — ideally in media, publishing, or a subscription\-led business.
 



 • Proven record of carrying and hitting sales/revenue targets.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with distribution logistics and managing vendor or retail partner networks.
 



 • Comfortable with subscription tools, payment gateways, and basic data analysis in spreadsheets.
 



 • Strong negotiation skills and willingness to travel for retail and event distribution.
 



**Good to Have** 




 • Experience with paywall, CRM, and email/marketing automation platforms.
 



 • Existing relationships with magazine distributors or retail chains.
 



 • Understanding of the enterprise and tech audience.

title: Vice President of Sales
description:
**About Astra:** 




 Astra Security is a leader in the penetration testing space, recognized by G2 in the Pentest category. With headquarters in the US \& India, Astra is the trusted security partner for leading brands including Muthoot Finance, Loom, CompTIA, NIIT, Goldcast, HackerRank, Sprinto, ITC \& more. Its one\-of\-a\-kind continuous pentest platform is trusted by 1,200\+ companies across 100\+ countries, from fast\-growing startups to Fortune 100 giants.
 



 Astra's autonomous pentest platform pairs AI agents with certified human pentesters to continuously pentest applications and infrastructure at scale. Vulnerabilities are discovered, validated, and chained the way a real attacker would. Beyond pentesting, Astra's suite includes a DAST Scanner, Cloud Vulnerability Scanner, and API Security Platform, giving teams continuous coverage across web apps, cloud environments, and APIs from a single dashboard. With over 18,000 vulnerabilities detected daily, Astra helps customers prevent millions in potential losses while saving thousands of developer hours. Last year alone, Astra uncovered more than 6\.8 million vulnerabilities for its customers.
 



 Astra's research team actively contributes to the OWASP community, including helping shape the OWASP Autonomous Penetration Testing Standard (APTS) and contributing to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Generative AI Security Risks. Astra is CREST\-accredited, CERT\-IN empaneled, and a PCI ASV, reflecting its commitment to the highest standards of security testing.
 



 We've been awarded by the President of France Mr. François Hollande at the La French Tech program and Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi at the Global Conference on Cyber Security. Loom, MamaEarth, Muthoot Finance, Canara Robeco, ScripBox etc. are a few of Astra’s customers.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills:** 



* 12\+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 5 years in a revenue or sales leadership role
* Proven track record of building and scaling revenue teams targeting the US and European markets
* Experience in cybersecurity or an adjacent technical SaaS vertical strongly preferred

* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to build revenue operations frameworks from the ground up
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive presence \- comfortable pitching to C\-suite and board audiences
* Experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM; ability to enforce CRM discipline across the team

**We Offer:** 



* Competitive compensation: salary, performance bonus, and eventually meaningful equity
